Reword the question so that it asks exactly the same thing in different words and a different sentence
structure. Keep every name, model, position number, article number, date and condition exactly. Do not add or
remove any detail. Return only the reworded question.

The manual of the MA STAR two post lift carries an EC declaration of conformity to Directive 2006/42/EC. For a unit of the same model placed on the market on 1 March 2027, must the CE marking be followed by the identification number of a notified body?

response.text: For a unit of the MA STAR two post lift model placed on the market on 1 March 2027, is it necessary for the CE marking to be accompanied by a notified body's identification number, given that the manual for that model includes an EC declaration of conformity under Directive 2006/42/EC?
